name: dealfinderr-deal-ai
description: Find, analyse, and save UK property deals with Dealfinderr in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Dealfinderr account to search indexed UK property deals, inspect a supported listing URL directly, research local Rent to SA nightly rates and occupancy by postcode, run Deal AI, and save completed results to your Dealfinderr deal groups. Market Research also supports buy to let and HMO estimates. Refurb analysis can continue into a BTL, HMO, serviced accommodation, or sale exit using the purchase case. Available strategies depend on the listing and your account access. Verify estimates and property details before acting.
defaultPrompt: Find property deals in Manchester and analyse one.
Analyse this Rightmove listing and save the result.
Research Rent to SA nightly rates and occupancy in M1.

positive.description: Inspect a supported sale listing without starting an analysis
positive.prompt: Inspect https://www.rightmove.co.uk/properties/93542115 and tell me which strategies are available. Do not run an analysis yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the verified listing summary, available strategies and reasons for unavailable strategies. Do not call analyze_deal or use an AI credit.

positive.description: Analyse and save a buy-to-let sale listing
positive.prompt: Use Dealfinderr to assess https://www.rightmove.co.uk/properties/93542115 as a buy-to-let investment, then save the completed result in a group named ChatGPT Review. Show the key figures and saved deal link.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the listing, run BTL, report the returned figures and warnings, and save the server-stored analysis to the named group. Return the saved deal link without inventing values.

positive.description: Read saved deals and reopen one result
positive.prompt: List my Dealfinderr saved deals. If I have one, open the most recently saved result and summarize its strategy, figures and link. Do not run a new analysis.
positive.expected_behavior: List only this account's saved deals and open the most recent one if present. If none exist, say so. Do not use an AI credit.

positive.description: Search indexed Below Last Sold opportunities
positive.prompt: Use Dealfinderr to find up to five below-last-sold sale listings in the M postcode area. Show the listing URLs and price signals. Do not run an analysis yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the negative-equity feed with areas M and limit 5. Show returned listing facts and source URLs, or say clearly if there are no results. Do not call analyze_deal or use an AI credit.

positive.description: Research serviced accommodation nightly rates and occupancy in a postcode district
positive.prompt: Use Dealfinderr to research the Rent to SA market in M1. Show the low, expected and high nightly rates, annual occupancy estimates, and projected accommodation revenue. Include the local monthly landlord rent for context.
positive.expected_behavior: Call research_market with postcode M1 and strategy r2sa. Report returned averageDailyRate in GBP per occupied night, averageOccupancy as an annual percentage, estimatedMonthlyRevenue in GBP, and averageLocalRent as monthly landlord rent. Show low, expected and high ranges, cache status, uncertainties and research link. Explain that a fresh estimate may use one AI credit.

negative.description: Unsupported listing host: do not invoke Dealfinderr for an arbitrary website.
negative.prompt: Analyse https://example.com/properties/93542115 as a property investment.

negative.description: US property request: Dealfinderr covers UK listings and postcode markets only.
negative.prompt: Find Florida property listings and estimate buy-to-let returns in Miami.

negative.description: Unsupported account mutation: the Dealfinderr plugin cannot change subscription or billing details.
negative.prompt: Use Dealfinderr to upgrade my plan and change my payment card.

publication.release_notes: Adds completed result lookup and saving Deal AI analyses, including Refurb exits, into Dealfinderr deal groups.
